entries.title: Subcritical gamma-thick-point dimensions
entries.statement: Scoped campaign derivation independently checked by the named referee. Fix gamma in (0,2). Let h be a whole-plane GFF and D_h its gamma-LQG metric, with deterministic dimension d_gamma. Let T_h^gamma={z: lim_{r->0} h_r(z)/log(1/r)=gamma}. For this fixed gamma, almost surely its Euclidean Hausdorff dimension is 2-gamma^2/2 and its D_h-Hausdorff dimension is d_gamma. These are published source inputs: Gwynne-Pfeffer equation (1.11) with deterministic ambient C, and Corollary 1.7. No numerical value of d_gamma is supplied.
assumptions: whole-plane GFF h with fixed additive normalization

entries.title: Refuted unrestricted metric KPZ bridge
entries.statement: REFUTED AUXILIARY BRIDGE; scoped campaign counterexample independently checked. Extending the independent-set metric KPZ equality dim_E(X)=xi*Q*dim_D(X)-(xi^2/2)*dim_D(X)^2 to every random Borel set X, with no restriction on dependence on the GFF h, is false. The published exact equality assumes deterministic X or random X independent of h. This failure concerns a proposed extension of a theorem, not the problem of determining the LQG metric dimension.
assumptions: distinguish Euclidean and metric Hausdorff dimensions

entries.title: Gamma-thick-point counterexample to unrestricted metric KPZ
entries.statement: Source-backed counterexample independently checked in the scoped campaign review. For every fixed gamma in (0,2), choose the field-dependent random Borel set X=T_h^gamma. Its Euclidean dimension is 2-gamma^2/2 and metric dimension d_gamma. With xi=gamma/d_gamma and Q=2/gamma+gamma/2, the unrestricted metric KPZ expression instead equals gamma*Q-gamma^2/2=2. The error is exactly gamma^2/2>0, and equals 4/3 at gamma=sqrt(8/3). Retain the published independence premise or use a valid dependent-set theorem. This counterexample does not compute d_gamma and is not a flaw attributed to a proof that already retains the premise.
assumptions: X is the gamma-thick-point set of the same field h
two published dimension inputs in thick-dimensions

relations.rationale: The counterexample substitutes the two exact source-backed dimensions of this same field-dependent set.
The proposed equality predicts 2 for the chosen set, differing from its actual Euclidean dimension by gamma^2/2>0.
